newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lockheed to study Manila aerospace center.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed to study Manila aerospace center.

text.p: U.S. aviation group Lockheed Martin Corp has signed an agreement with local firm H. Thomas Group Inc (HTGI) to study the viability of setting up a Philippine aerospace center, the presidential palace said on Tuesday.
A palace statement said the two sides signed the agreement in the presence of President Fidel Ramos on Monday.
Lockheed Martin had been evaluating a number of projects related to the modernisation programme of the Armed Force of the Philippines.
HTGI is a holding company headed by young Filipino entrepreneurs with investments in the transportation and telecommunications industry.
